requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-FUN-001 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: The controller shall start the automatic fill-transfer-drain sequence upon a valid START command when the process is idle or paused.
requirements.text: The controller shall start the automatic fill-transfer-drain sequence upon a valid START command when the process is idle or paused.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-FUN-002 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: The automatic sequence shall open inlet valve V1 to fill Tank 1.
requirements.text: The automatic sequence shall open inlet valve V1 to fill Tank 1.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-FUN-003 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: When Tank 1 reaches its high-level limit, V1 shall close.
requirements.text: When Tank 1 reaches its high-level limit, V1 shall close.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-FUN-004 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: After Tank 1 reaches the high-level limit, the controller shall wait 10 s before opening V2.
requirements.text: After Tank 1 reaches the high-level limit, the controller shall wait 10 s before opening V2.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-FUN-005 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: V2 shall transfer liquid from Tank 1 to Tank 2 until Tank 1 reaches its low-level limit.
requirements.text: V2 shall transfer liquid from Tank 1 to Tank 2 until Tank 1 reaches its low-level limit.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-FUN-006 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: After Tank 1 reaches the low-level limit, the controller shall wait 10 s before opening V3.
requirements.text: After Tank 1 reaches the low-level limit, the controller shall wait 10 s before opening V3.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-FUN-007 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: V3 shall drain Tank 2 until Tank 2 reaches its low-level limit.
requirements.text: V3 shall drain Tank 2 until Tank 2 reaches its low-level limit.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-FUN-008 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: After Tank 2 reaches its low-level limit, the controller shall return to the Tank 1 filling operation after 10 s.
requirements.text: After Tank 2 reaches its low-level limit, the controller shall return to the Tank 1 filling operation after 10 s.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-MOD-001 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: STOP shall close V1, V2 and V3 and place the controller in a paused condition.
requirements.text: STOP shall close V1, V2 and V3 and place the controller in a paused condition.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-MOD-002 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: A START command following STOP shall continue the sequence from the point at which STOP was accepted.
requirements.text: A START command following STOP shall continue the sequence from the point at which STOP was accepted.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-MOD-003 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: SHUT shall command V2 and V3 open to drain both tanks and shall inhibit V1.
requirements.text: SHUT shall command V2 and V3 open to drain both tanks and shall inhibit V1.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-MOD-004 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: After shutdown draining is complete, all three valves shall be closed and the controller shall be in the initial idle configuration.
requirements.text: After shutdown draining is complete, all three valves shall be closed and the controller shall be in the initial idle configuration.

requirements.quote: Req ID: URS-SAF-001 | Source / Rev: URS-001 Rev A | Requirement Text: On loss of controller power, all process valves shall move to or remain in the closed position.
requirements.text: On loss of controller power, all process valves shall move to or remain in the closed position.
